style: Photorealistic, shot on a full-frame camera with a 28mm lens, vertical 9:16 composition, cinematic colour grading with rich saturated colours, crisp detail, natural light. No people anywhere. No real brand names or logos; every sign and billboard shows invented colourful abstract graphics without readable words.

plates.prompt: Establishing shot across the harbor: a huge green copper statue of a robed woman raising a torch, standing on a tall stone pedestal on a small island on the left, and a dense New York-style skyline of glass skyscrapers across sparkling blue water on the right, deep blue sky with long streaky white clouds, bright morning sun.

Street-level view straight down a famous busy Manhattan-style avenue at golden hour, towering skyscrapers on both sides covered top to bottom in giant glowing LED billboards with bright abstract colourful graphics, a few yellow taxis parked at the curbs, traffic lights, steam rising from a street vent, an empty road in the middle with a white zebra crossing in the foreground, warm sunset light between the towers.

View from about 4 metres high over the middle of a huge New York-style intersection at dusk, wide empty zebra crossings in the centre, yellow taxis stopped in all four directions, glass and brick skyscrapers all around wrapped in glowing billboards with abstract colourful graphics, traffic lights glowing red, wet asphalt reflecting neon, blue-purple sky.

Looking steeply up from the middle of a Manhattan-style avenue between towering skyscrapers converging toward a bright orange and purple sunset sky, glass and stone facades with lit windows, a few billboards glowing near the bottom.

Interior of a high-tech private biology laboratory at night, polished steel benches, rows of colourful test tubes, glowing monitors with green graphs, and in the centre a glass terrarium tank glowing bright green, cool teal light, glass wall behind with a night city skyline.
Bright daytime plaza in front of a modern glass hospital skyscraper, a red-carpeted stage with a wooden podium in the centre foreground, gold and white balloons, red velvet ropes, flags, blue sky.

Huge luxury teenage boy's penthouse bedroom, floor-to-ceiling window showing a sunny New York-style skyline, a mountain of brightly wrapped gift boxes with ribbons in the middle, a gold gaming chair and a giant TV, pink neon light strip, modern furniture, daylight.

Huge luxury teenage boy's penthouse bedroom at night, lights off, floor-to-ceiling window showing a glittering New York-style skyline at night, moonlight on a mountain of wrapped gift boxes, a gold gaming chair, soft pink neon strip glowing, deep blue shadows.

Grand hallway of a wealthy private academy, polished wooden floor, tall wooden trophy cabinet with glass doors full of shining gold trophies and medals, navy and gold banners on cream walls, warm morning sunlight through tall arched windows.

Entrance of an exclusive nightclub on a New York-style street at night, dark brick facade, a glowing pink and purple neon sign of abstract shapes above a black door, gold posts with a red velvet rope, wet pavement reflecting the neon, fire escapes above.

Grand white neoclassical mansion at night seen from its driveway, tall white columns, tall gold-trimmed double doors at the top of wide marble steps, warm golden lights in every window, a lit marble fountain in front, trimmed hedges, gold lamp posts, deep blue night sky.

Close view of the top of wide marble steps in front of a grand white mansion at night, tall white columns on both sides, tall gold-trimmed double doors slightly open with warm light spilling out, a glowing lantern.
